provenance.notes: LiveCodeBench v6 78.9, Terminal Bench 2 49.4. Within 4.4 points of the 397B at less than a third of the weights.
Knowledge benchmark only; no hallucination-rate figure is published for this model.
IFBench 76.1. The highest IFEval figure in this catalogue — above the 397B's 92.6 and Llama 3.3 70B's 92.1.
MMLU-Pro 86.7. Two points behind the 397B on GPQA.
Terminal Bench 2 49.4 — essentially level with the 397B's 72.9 on BFCL.

provenance.quantNote: Editorial derivation: no drop from the measured bf16 figure. 6-8 bit is effectively lossless on a model this size — the differences that show up at 4-bit and below are not measurable here. Recorded explicitly rather than left to band fallback, which would otherwise borrow the 4-bit number and subtract a point.
